script: A German fisherman's find cracked a family's impossible mystery. In 1945, an American soldier vanished crossing the Rhine river, and his family spent decades not knowing what really happened to him. Fifty four years later, a fisherman pulled an old rusted helmet out of the riverbed, tangled in his net. Inside the helmet was a name, barely readable, scratched by hand. Researchers traced that name across an ocean, back to a small town in Ohio, to a family that had waited half a century for an answer. A single helmet, sitting in the mud for fifty four years, finally told them exactly where their soldier had been lost. A German fisherman's find had cracked a mystery no one thought would ever be solved.
